plan.description: Read-only planning and architecture agent. Use this to scope out a change before implementing it — it cannot edit files or run bash.

build.description: Default implementation agent: writes code, runs tests, fixes bugs.

review.description: Reviews a diff, PR, or file for bugs, security issues and style problems. Never edits code.

docs.description: Writes and maintains documentation: READMEs, code comments, ADRs.

test.template: Run the project's test suite. Report any failures with file:line references, then fix the ones that are safe and obvious to fix.
test.description: Run tests and fix obvious failures

commit.template: Run `git diff --cached` (and `git diff` if nothing is staged) to see the pending changes, then write a concise, conventional-commits style commit message that explains *why*, and create the commit.
commit.description: Draft and create a commit from the current changes

pr-review.template: Review the diff between the current branch and $ARGUMENTS (default: main) for correctness, security and style issues. Do not make any edits — only report findings.
pr-review.description: Review the current branch's diff against a base branch

docs-update.template: Look at $ARGUMENTS (default: the current diff) and update any README, docstrings, or docs that are now out of date.
docs-update.description: Sync docs with recent code changes
